claimedSlice: opencv2/cudacodec.hpp parser-backed CUDA codec public declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaCodec wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudacodec module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS/Apple/WinRT; real encoding/decoding depends on the external CUDA toolkit/runtime and NVIDIA Video Codec SDK/NVCUVID/NVCUVENC availability.

The module requires opencv_videoio, opencv_cudaarithm, opencv_cudawarping, and optionally opencv_cudaimgproc/opencv_cudev, with GpuMat/Stream, VideoReader/VideoWriter, callback, and asynchronous ownership contracts outside this package; no CUDA codec wrapper/runtime is bundled.
